title: dev-code-review eval case.json — one answer key in the reviewer's eval set
description: The answer key of one reviewer eval case, tracked at .claude/skills/dev-code-review/evals/cases/<id>/case.json beside change.diff, base/ and (optionally) fix.json. A `bad` case names the confirmed bug location(s) the reviewer must find (recall); a `clean` case is a diff a human confirmed has nothing to flag (false-flag rate). Read by reviewer_eval.py check/score; NEVER copied into the reviewer's sandbox by materialize. Cross-field rule DEV-REVIEW-EVAL-K1 (validate.py): kind=bad needs a non-empty `bugs` with line_end >= line_start, kind=clean has no bugs, and any non-seed case carries source.ref and source.confirmed_by.

id.description: Equals the case directory name (enforced by reviewer_eval.py check, not the schema).

kind.description: The one branch field. bad = scored for recall; clean = scored for false flags.

ticket.description: A key matching project.ticket_key_pattern, e.g. PROJ-123. Becomes the evidence key when the case is materialized.

bugs.description: The confirmed bug locations. Each range must sit on lines change.diff ADDS (the reviewer only judges the diff).

line_start.description: New-file line where the confirmed bug starts.

class.description: The reviewer dimension the bug belongs to. masking additionally requires review.masking=true to count as caught.

pattern.description: Free label for humans, e.g. swallowed-exception.

origin.description: Where the case came from. seed = authored for the kit, not a real incident.

ref.description: The run key or PR ref the case came from. Required for a non-seed case.

confirmed_by.description: The human who confirmed the bug location, or confirmed the diff clean. Required for a non-seed case.
